scenarios.title: Get help
scenarios.prompt: Review the login page change in PR 812 with help from one other agent, then report.
scenarios.passes: A review channel is opened or reused; the helper is spawned with join on it (or a persona that subscribes to it); the brief is posted there, not DMed; the helper is despawned or despawns itself at the end.

scenarios.title: Share, don't DM
scenarios.prompt: Tell bob the build is green and the tests pass.
scenarios.passes: A channel post (a mention is fine), no DM.

scenarios.title: Private
scenarios.prompt: Ask bob for the staging password he mentioned.

scenarios.title: Role pool
scenarios.prompt: Get a frontend review of issue #812. Answers go to #review.checkout.
scenarios.passes: cotal_anycast with role "review-frontend" and the channel named in the text; no spawn.

present.name: frontend_a
present.prompt: Set your status with cotal_status to say you are waiting for review-frontend requests. Then wait for one.

present.name: frontend_b
present.prompt: Set your status with cotal_status to say you are waiting for review-frontend requests. Then wait for one.

scenarios.title: No pool
scenarios.prompt: Get a frontend review of issue #812. Answers go to #review.checkout.
scenarios.passes: No anycast; a named mention, a DM or a spawned helper instead.

scenarios.title: Reach a family
scenarios.prompt: Announce the code freeze to every review channel.
scenarios.passes: No send to review.>; a post on review.announce or one per channel. If a pattern send is tried, the agent recovers from the refusal without asking the user.

review.announce.description: Notices for everyone on the review channels

scenarios.title: One job, then stop
scenarios.prompt: Have a helper summarise CHANGELOG.md on #general and stop.
scenarios.passes: The helper's prompt tells it to despawn itself (or once: true), and it leaves the roster.

scenarios.title: Scope a helper
scenarios.prompt: Start an agent that triages #bugs.checkout and touches nothing else.
scenarios.passes: A persona saved with cotal_persona whose channels are limited to bugs.checkout, then spawned by name; no spawn on alice's own permissions.

bugs.checkout.description: Bug reports for the checkout flow
